extra.test_case: Vehicle-level functional test: the traffic-related intensity decrease is activated only at speed <= 20 km/h or following distance <= 20 m. The reduced intensity stays within the regulation minimum.

extra.text: As long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 50 km/h the intensity decrease already activated may remain active.
extra.test_case: Vehicle-level functional test: an already activated decrease is cancelled once vehicle speed exceeds 50 km/h.

extra.text: No sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition.
extra.test_case: Record luminous intensity versus time during transitions; the variation is gradual, with no step or abrupt change observable.

extra.text: It may be possible for the driver to set the functions above to static luminous intensities.
extra.test_case: If a driver override is provided, verify the lamps hold a static intensity within the regulation limits when it is selected.

extra.text: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
extra.test_case: With the vehicle electrical system in a constant voltage operating condition representative of the M1 category as specified by the applicant, measure the voltage at the device terminals. Pass if it does not exceed the voltage stated in the device's type approval documentation.

extra.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
extra.test_case: With the vehicle electrical system in a constant voltage operating condition representative of the category, measure the terminal voltage. Pass if it is ≤ 6.75 V + 3 % (6.95 V).

extra.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
extra.test_case: With the vehicle electrical system in a constant voltage operating condition representative of the category, measure the terminal voltage. Pass if it is ≤ 13.5 V + 3 % (13.905 V).

extra.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
extra.test_case: With the vehicle electrical system in a constant voltage operating condition representative of the category, measure the terminal voltage. Pass if it is ≤ 28 V + 3 % (28.84 V).

extra.text: The means of controlling the maximum voltage at the terminals of the device may, for convenience, be located within the body of the device.
extra.test_case: Design review: if voltage limiting is integrated in the lamp housing, check that the terminal voltage limits of paragraph 5.27.2 are still met under constant voltage operating conditions.

extra.text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity.
extra.test_case: Installation inspection on vehicle: check each function's angles of geometric visibility from infinity (or with parallel-shifted observation direction); pass if no vehicle part obstructs light from any part of the apparent surface, except obstacles already present at lamp type approval.

extra.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
extra.test_case: Photometric measurement of the lamp with the hidden portion masked as on the vehicle; pass if values meet the photometric requirements of the device approval regulation.

extra.text: A LED module does not need to be replaceable, if so stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
extra.test_case: Document review: if the LED modules are non-replaceable, check that the communication sheet of the component type approval states this. Pass if the statement is present, or if the LED modules are replaceable.

extra.text: Presence of the reversing lamp: Mandatory on motor vehicles.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: confirm a reversing lamp function is fitted on the M1 vehicle; pass if present.

extra.text: Number: One device mandatory and a second device optional on motor vehicles of category M1.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: count reversing lamp devices fitted (handed pair); pass if 1 or 2 devices.

extra.text: In height: not less than 250 mm above the ground.
extra.test_case: Measure height of the lowest edge of the apparent surface above ground on the vehicle in unladen condition; pass if >= 250 mm.

extra.text: In height: not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
extra.test_case: Measure height of the highest edge of the apparent surface above ground on the vehicle in unladen condition; pass if <= 1,200 mm.

extra.text: Devices installed at the rear of the vehicle: Geometric visibility defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards.
extra.test_case: Geometric visibility check of the apparent surface on vehicle per para 2.10.7; pass if unobstructed over 15° up and 5° down.

extra.text: Devices installed at the rear of the vehicle: Geometric visibility defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device.
extra.test_case: With a single reversing lamp fitted, check apparent surface visibility per para 2.10.7; pass if unobstructed over 45° left and right.

extra.text: Devices installed at the rear of the vehicle: Geometric visibility defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: β = 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.
extra.test_case: With two reversing lamps fitted, check apparent surface visibility per para 2.10.7; pass if unobstructed over 45° outwards and 30° inwards for each lamp.

extra.text: Orientation: Rearwards.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify reference axis of the reversing lamp is directed rearwards; pass if oriented rearwards.

extra.text: Tell-tale optional, however a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
extra.test_case: Check R23/R148 failure provisions; if required, simulate LED failure and verify tell-tale indication; pass if failure tell-tale operates when required.

extra.text: Devices of S1 or S2 categories: mandatory on all categories of vehicles.
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify S1 or S2 category stop lamps are fitted on the M1 vehicle; pass if present.

extra.text: Two S1 or S2 category devices on all categories of vehicles.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: count S1/S2 stop lamp devices at the rear; pass if exactly two (one in each left/right unit).

extra.text: For S1 or S2 categories devices: Above the ground, not less than 350 mm.
extra.test_case: Measure height of lowest point of apparent surface above ground with vehicle in unladen condition per para 5.8.1; pass if ≥ 350 mm.

extra.text: For S1 or S2 categories devices: at the rear of the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the stop lamp is located at the rear of the vehicle; pass if rear-mounted.

extra.text: However, for the stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
extra.test_case: Measure mounting height per para 5.8.1; if below 750 mm, verify inward visibility under H plane is at least 20°; pass if condition and angle met.

extra.text: Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
extra.test_case: Measure mounting height per para 5.8.1; if below 750 mm, verify downward visibility of at least 5°; pass if condition and angle met.

extra.text: Orientation Towards the rear of the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify reference axis of the stop lamp is directed towards the rear of the vehicle; pass if rearward.

extra.text: The stop lamps need not function if the device, which starts and/or stops the propulsion system, is in a position that makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate.
extra.test_case: Functional test: with propulsion start/stop device in a position preventing operation, apply brake; stop lamp may remain OFF; pass if behaviour otherwise complies with 6.7.7.1 when propulsion is operable.

extra.text: Tell-tale optional, however a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
extra.test_case: Check component regulation (UN R7/R148) requirements; if failure tell-tale required, simulate stop lamp failure and verify tell-tale activation; pass if tell-tale operates.

extra.text: Rear position lamp devices of R or R1 or R2 categories: Mandatory.
extra.test_case: Check the approval marking on the lamp: category R, R1 or R2 is present.

extra.text: Number of rear position lamps: Two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: exactly two mandatory rear position lamps are fitted, each carrying a UN R7 (02 or later) or UN R148 (00 or later) approval marking.

extra.text: In width: that point on the apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the distance from the outermost point of the apparent surface (along the reference axis) to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle: pass if ≤ 400 mm on each side.

extra.text: In height: the rear position lamp shall be above the ground not less than 350 mm.
extra.test_case: Measure per paragraph 5.8.1 on the unladen vehicle: lowest point of the apparent surface ≥ 350 mm above ground.

extra.text: In height: the rear position lamp shall be above the ground not more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
extra.test_case: Measure per paragraph 5.8.1: highest point of the apparent surface ≤ 1,500 mm above ground (≤ 2,100 mm only where justified by bodywork shape).

extra.text: In length: the rear position lamp shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: lamp is located on the rear of the vehicle.

extra.text: Geometric visibility of the rear position lamp: Horizontal angle: 45° inwards.
extra.test_case: Geometric visibility check per paragraph 2.13 on the vehicle: apparent surface visible over 45° inwards (or 20° under the H plane if mounted below 750 mm).

extra.text: Geometric visibility of the rear position lamp: Horizontal angle: 80° outwards.
extra.test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle: apparent surface visible up to 80° outwards without obstruction by bodywork.

extra.text: Where a rear position lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
extra.test_case: Verify the mounting height < 750 mm per 5.8.1 before applying the reduced 20° inward angle below the H plane.

extra.text: Geometric visibility of the rear position lamp: Vertical angle: 15° above the horizontal.
extra.test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle: apparent surface visible up to 15° above the horizontal.

extra.text: Geometric visibility of the rear position lamp: Vertical angle: 15° below the horizontal.
extra.test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle: apparent surface visible down to 15° below the horizontal (5° if mounted below 750 mm).

extra.text: Where a rear position lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
extra.test_case: Verify the mounting height < 750 mm per 5.8.1 before applying the reduced 5° downward angle.

extra.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, Horizontal angle: 45° outwards to 45° inwards.
extra.test_case: If the alternative is chosen, confirm a rear side-marker lamp is fitted; then verify visibility from 45° outwards to 45° inwards.

extra.text: Under the alternative of paragraph 6.10.5.2., where a rear position lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
extra.test_case: Verify the mounting height < 750 mm per 5.8.1 before applying the reduced 20° inward angle below the H plane.

extra.text: Under the alternative of paragraph 6.10.5.2., Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal.
extra.test_case: Geometric visibility check: visible from 15° above to 15° below the horizontal.

extra.text: Under the alternative of paragraph 6.10.5.2., where a rear position lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
extra.test_case: Verify the mounting height < 750 mm per 5.8.1 before applying the reduced 5° downward angle.

extra.text: Orientation of the rear position lamp: Rearwards.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: reference axis of the lamp is directed rearwards.

extra.text: Electrical connections of the rear position lamp: In accordance with paragraph 5.11.
extra.test_case: Functional test on the vehicle: rear position lamps switch ON together with front position lamps, end-outline marker, side-marker and registration plate lamps as required by 5.11.

extra.text: Tell-tale for the rear position lamp: Closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory.
extra.test_case: Vehicle check: a closed-circuit tell-tale illuminates when the rear position lamps are switched ON.

extra.text: The closed-circuit tell-tale shall be combined with that of the front position lamps.
extra.test_case: Vehicle check: the same tell-tale indicates both front and rear position lamps ON (not required when daytime running lamps are ON).

extra.text: Presence of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular: Mandatory on motor vehicles.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the rear non-triangular retro-reflectors are fitted on the M1 vehicle; pass if present.

extra.text: Number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular: Two.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: count the mandatory rear retro-reflectors on the vehicle; pass if two (one per handed lamp).

extra.text: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4. below), are permitted provided they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection of any additional retro-reflecting devices or materials; pass if they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.

extra.text: In height: Above the ground, not less than 250 mm.
extra.test_case: Measure height of the lowest point of the illuminating surface above the ground with the unladen vehicle per paragraph 5.8; pass if ≥ 250 mm.

extra.text: In height: Above the ground, not more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively).
extra.test_case: Measure height of the highest point of the illuminating surface above the ground; pass if ≤ 900 mm, or ≤ 1,200 mm when grouped with rear lamp(s) (as in this combination lamp), or ≤ 1,500 mm where bodywork shape prevents compliance.

extra.text: In length: at the rear of the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: pass if the retro-reflector is located at the rear of the vehicle.

extra.text: Geometric visibility: Horizontal angle: 30° inwards.
extra.test_case: Check geometric visibility of the illuminating surface on the vehicle or by drawing; pass if unobstructed through 30° inwards.

extra.text: Geometric visibility: Horizontal angle: 30° outwards.
extra.test_case: Check geometric visibility of the illuminating surface; pass if unobstructed through 30° outwards.

extra.text: Geometric visibility: Vertical angle: 10° above horizontal.
extra.test_case: Check geometric visibility of the illuminating surface; pass if unobstructed through 10° above horizontal.

extra.text: Orientation: Rearwards.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: pass if the reference axis of the retro-reflector is oriented rearwards.

extra.text: In their respective planes, the zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer are bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground.
extra.test_case: Visual check per paragraph 5.10.4 and Annex 4 on the vehicle: observer's eye moved within zone 1 from 1 m to 2.2 m above the ground. Pass: no red light from the rear position or stop lamp directly visible to the front.

extra.text: In their respective planes, the zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer are bounded in width by two vertical planes which, forming to the front and to the rear respectively an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, pass through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width.
extra.test_case: Geometric and visual check per Annex 4 on the vehicle: define the zone boundaries at 15° outwards through the overall-width contact points. Pass: no red light from the rear position or stop lamp directly visible to the front within zone 1. Any white light to the rear within zone 2 comes only from the reversing lamp, as permitted by paragraph 5.10.

extra.text: If there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane and the rearmost to the rearward plane.
extra.test_case: Review of the vehicle overall-width contact points. Pass: the forward zone plane passes through the foremost contact point and the rearward zone plane passes through the rearmost contact point.

extra.text: The values measured for the distances shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
extra.test_case: Compare measured width, height and length distances with the individual installation specifications for each lamp function; pass if all are within the limits.

extra.text: The values measured for the angles shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
extra.test_case: Compare measured geometric visibility angles with the individual specifications for each lamp; pass if fulfilled, with an allowance of ±3º on the angle limits.

extra.text: The lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
extra.test_case: Operate the lamp controls (lights switch, brake, reverse gear); pass if switching behaviour meets paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. and the individual specifications for each lamp.

extra.text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
extra.test_case: Compare the inspection results with paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. and the individual specifications for each lamp; pass if all requirements are met.
